steps.name: onboarding
steps.note: Welcome, three questions, AI setup and "Open Diomedes", each with its own control.

steps.name: path-guard-refusal
steps.note: A guarded folder is refused in words and the dialog stays open to correct: "This folder or file is private and cannot be opened by Diomedes."

steps.name: open-repository
steps.note: Opened greet-kit with the Console's own "Open a folder as a project" control.

steps.name: make-the-task
steps.note: Made from the Board's New task control; the row is in Ready.

steps.name: engine-setup
steps.note: OpenCode: "Native OpenCode Go account connected. Choose an explicit provider/model.". 15 models advertised; opencode-go/glm-5.2 set as the default on opencode:opencode-go.

steps.name: open-the-task-thread
steps.note: The board row's task name opens (and, the first time, makes) the task's thread.

steps.name: activate-software-engineering-pack
steps.note: Software Engineering is on; 1 instruction files recorded; 0 grants and 0 needs — activation granted nothing.

steps.name: inspect-project-instructions
steps.note: "Project instructions loaded · AGENTS.md" — AGENTS.md opens and reads back "# Rules for this repository 1. Keep every file under twenty lines. 2. Say a thin". Nothing here reaches a model (HAR-01).

steps.name: choose-the-model-on-the-thread
steps.note: The thread picker offers 16 choices including OpenCode models.

steps.name: known-failure-account-unavailable
steps.note: Confirmed and sent; refused with: "Turn the selected engine on in Settings before using it." — no substitute route ran.

steps.name: recover-by-turning-the-engine-back-on
steps.note: The refusal named the control that fixes it; the switch in Settings > Engines is that control.

steps.name: assign-the-bounded-change
steps.note: "Send this task?" confirmed. Session ended waiting on opencode-go/glm-5.2; OpenCode turns so far: 1.

steps.name: exact-proposal
steps.note: The proposal names exactly NOTES.md and shows its text before any write.

steps.name: approve-and-record-the-write
steps.note: Approved; 1 change record(s) for NOTES.md; History says "opencode-go/glm-5.2 changed 1 file".

steps.name: review-the-diff
steps.note: 1 change(s) show before and after and are kept from the Workbook Review page. The Console has no keep or undo control: Shell.tsx defines reviewChange and wires it to nothing.

steps.name: edit-an-existing-source-file
steps.note: No Console control selects a source document, and with an empty selection a text route may only create files (server/native-work.ts). The obvious change inside src/greet.js cannot be assigned here.

steps.name: second-assignment-for-stop
steps.note: Confirmed and started a second run to stop; OpenCode turns: 2.

steps.name: queue-a-follow-up-while-in-flight
steps.note: Queued under the composer while the run was in flight; the queue states when it would run.

steps.name: stop-the-task
steps.note: Stopped the task. It reached what was running. 1 queued follow-up was cancelled. Provider work already sent can complete and be charged after Stop.

steps.name: follow-up-fate
steps.note: Also list the exported names in NOTES.md.Cancelled · Cancelled by Stop (task). (recorded state: cancelled)

steps.name: inspect-history
steps.note: History opens with 1 day(s) of entries, but the Console's History button switches the surface to the frozen Workbook and downgrades Technical detail to Standard.

steps.name: reopen-check
steps.note: Reopened; greet-kit is listed again and History keeps 1 day(s).

knownFailure.induced: OpenCode turned off in Settings > Engines while it is the task's route (0 turns spent)
knownFailure.recoveryActionSeen: Turn the selected engine on in Settings before using it.

pathGuard.said: This folder or file is private and cannot be opened by Diomedes.

stop.receipt: Stopped the task. It reached what was running. 1 queued follow-up was cancelled. Provider work already sent can complete and be charged after Stop.

followUp.queued: Also list the exported names in NOTES.md.
followUp.fate: Also list the exported names in NOTES.md.Cancelled · Cancelled by Stop (task). (recorded state: cancelled)

backendPreparation.why: check the picker against the catalogue the app advertises
confirm the History the Workbook page renders
confirm the repository survived a restart

limitations: edit-an-existing-source-file (not-reachable): No Console control selects a source document, and with an empty selection a text route may only create files (server/native-work.ts). The obvious change inside src/greet.js cannot be assigned here.
